verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official open-source CLI (github.com/ramp-public/ramp-cli), installable via an install script or Homebrew. It is built for agents: `--agent` JSON output (the default when piped), `--no-input` for CI, browser OAuth plus headless client-credentials `agent login`, profile switching, and 12 resources spanning bills, cards, funds, transactions, reimbursements, travel and more. Ramp's docs position it as the channel for coding agents and scripted workflows, and a probe confirms the repo exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI's behavior in real agent workflows beyond first-party docs and an existence probe.
